summary: Implements Utaku Elite Guard's army-scoped Battle-Maiden boost (issue #170), the third and last of the aggregate/group Force effects sequenced with Senior Infantry Legion (#162/PR #163) and Ashigaru Elite (#166/PR #167). New ArmyBattleMaidenBoost(card) is the same static 'boost others' shape as Senior Infantry Legion, but keyword-based (Battle Maiden) rather than type-based (Follower), and army-scoped (every OTHER Battle-Maiden card the owner controls at the same battlefield, not confined to one unit) rather than unit-scoped -- counts other same-owner same-province Zone.Battlefield Personalities with Effect=='boost-battle-maidens-in-army', excluding the card itself. Plugged into both PersonalityForce and FollowerForce. Shared-file note: all changed files are within L5R.Core (rules engine) and its test suite, plus docs/ROADMAP.md -- a single rules-lane primitive change; no UI/client files touched. This branch is stacked on mdornbrook/164-ashigaru-elite-boost (PR #167, itself stacked on #163) rather than branched independently off main, since all three were built while GitHub Actions billing on this repo was blocking CI; will retarget to main as each earlier PR merges.
validation: New ArmyBattleMaidenBoostPrimitive test: the guard does not boost itself; a Battle Maiden Personality in a different unit (same army) is boosted; a Battle Maiden Follower is boosted; a non-Battle-Maiden card, a Battle Maiden not at this battlefield, and the enemy's own Battle Maiden are all unaffected; two guards in one army grant each other but never themselves. Full suite: 101/101 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes (13/13 AI, 5/5 server integration, 4/4 client transport integration).
remaining: Infrastructure only -- no published card needs it yet (Utaku Elite Guard is not imported). This closes out the three-card aggregate/group Force effects sequence the user specced in one message; no further card in this sequence is outstanding.
